# apple_sandbox_tester (Resource)

Sets a sandbox tester's storefront and purchase testing options. Sandbox Apple Accounts are created in App Store Connect, so this resource manages an existing tester by email and fails if there is none; destroying it leaves the tester. Clear its purchase history with `apple_clear_sandbox_purchase_history`. Import it by email.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_sandbox_tester" "ann" {
  email                     = "ann.sandbox@example.com"
  territory                 = "JPN"
  subscription_renewal_rate = "MONTHLY_RENEWAL_EVERY_FIVE_MINUTES"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address of the sandbox Apple Account.

### Optional

- `interrupt_purchases` (Boolean) Whether purchases are interrupted, to test interrupted purchase flows.
- `subscription_renewal_rate` (String) How fast monthly subscriptions renew: `MONTHLY_RENEWAL_EVERY_ONE_HOUR`, `MONTHLY_RENEWAL_EVERY_THIRTY_MINUTES`, `MONTHLY_RENEWAL_EVERY_FIFTEEN_MINUTES`, `MONTHLY_RENEWAL_EVERY_FIVE_MINUTES`, `MONTHLY_RENEWAL_EVERY_THREE_MINUTES`.
- `territory` (String) Storefront of the tester, e.g. `USA`.

### Read-Only

- `apple_pay_compatible` (Boolean) Whether the tester can test Apple Pay.
- `first_name` (String) First name of the tester.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the sandbox tester.
- `last_name` (String) Last name of the tester.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_sandbox_tester.ann
  identity = {
    email = "ann.sandbox@example.com"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `email` (String) Email address of the sandbox Apple Account.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_sandbox_tester.ann ann.sandbox@example.com
```
